name: Oracle WebLogic Server
version_grain: release line as the Lifetime Support Policy names it (14.1.x, 12.2.x)

versions.label: 15.x
versions.note: Row 'Oracle Weblogic Server 15.x' (15c Releases). The vendor gives months only: release_date is the first day of the month, end dates the last day. Sustaining Support Ends: Indefinite.

versions.label: 14.1.x
versions.note: Row 'Oracle Weblogic Server 14.1.x' (14c Releases). GA Date reads 'Mar 2020 – Dec 2024' (14.1.1 to 14.1.2); release_date uses the first month. The vendor gives months only: release_date is the first day of the month, end dates the last day. Sustaining Support Ends: Indefinite. Error correction dates per patch set are in My Oracle Support (login).

versions.label: 12.2.x
versions.note: Row 'Oracle WebLogic Server 12.2.x' (Cloud Application Foundation 12c). The vendor gives months only: release_date is the first day of the month, end dates the last day. Sustaining Support Ends: Indefinite. Footnote 8: the 12.2.1.3 error correction period ended June 2023; bug fixes and patches need the latest 12.2.1.x patch set.

versions.label: 12.1.x
versions.note: Row 'Oracle WebLogic Server 12.1.x'. GA Date reads 'Dec 2011 – Jul 2014'; release_date uses the first month. Extended Support Ends reads 'Dec 2019' with footnote 7: Extended Support for WebLogic Server 12.1.3 runs January 1, 2020 through January 31, 2022 (Severity 1 and security fixes only). The 2022-01-31 date applies to 12.1.3 only; 12.1.1 and 12.1.2 ended Extended Support in Dec 2019. The vendor gives months only: release_date is the first day of the month, end dates the last day. Sustaining Support Ends: Indefinite. The 2022-01-31 extended date is the exact day given by footnote 7.
